name: Hondou Sayaka
source:
The gifted type who can handle just about anything with quiet competence, though she rarely pushes herself to the forefront. Because of that, she naturally falls into the role of the “older sister” within the group of seven. She comes across as gentle and reserved, but her thinking can be surprisingly sharp and uncompromising. Physically, however, she’s on the frail side. She isn’t a vegetarian, but she has little taste for meat. A refined yamato nadeshiko, she practices the tea ceremony and aikidou.

[From the [https://web.archive.org/web/20240521122532/https://xuse.co.jp/product/053_farthest2015/pageCharacter.html]official site[/url].]
